name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_group: Eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers under the scheme guidelines
eligibility: Eligibility is subject to the current PMMVY guidelines.
Benefits are subject to scheme conditions and verification.
benefits: Maternity benefit through Direct Benefit Transfer; current scheme provides ₹5,000 for the first living child and ₹6,000 for a second child when the second child is a girl, subject to conditions.
documents: Other documents prescribed by the portal
application_process: Apply through the official PMMVY portal or with assistance from Anganwadi/ASHA workers, as applicable.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development / Government of India
